scenes.label: Do I need fancy kit?
scenes.vo: Think you need fancy kit to film your nets?
All you need is your phone, a tripod and a net.
Set the tripod up behind the stumps at the bowler's end.

scenes.label: Got it ✓
scenes.vo: Then watch every ball back in slow-mo.
Your clips stay on your phone, nobody else sees them.
And the app is free to start.
Follow Crease Cam for the launch.
